heartRate.title: Heart rate
heartRate.info: How many times your heart beats per minute.

rr.title: RR interval
rr.info: Time between heartbeats. Shorter intervals mean a faster heart rate.

activity.title: Activity
activity.info: How much the sensor moves. Taller bars mean more movement.

rssi.title: Signal strength
rssi.info: Bluetooth signal strength. Closer to zero means a stronger signal.

delay.title: Packet delay
delay.info: How long sensor data takes to reach your phone, based on the sensor’s clock.
